Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
How would you like to work in IT, toying with cutting edge technologies and enjoying your life? At Orange Services , it’s possible!
 As one of the largest IT Hub within Orange Group, we are working internationally for both Orange corporate functions and country operations. Through a unique combination of know-how and expertise, our teams provide a broad range of IT & Business Solutions.
 Come closer to #LifeAtOrange !
 What we’re looking for 
 We are looking to expand our team with a highly motivated, innovative and results-oriented Full Stack Developer that will help us set an efficient, powerful and highly available system while also keeping an eye on best practices, clean code and enrolling of newcomers.
 The project manages and monitors fleets of SIMs on behalf of multiple countries, with millions of records to track, follow and interrogate and is part of a larger context that involves teams from Romania and France, all working together in an ‘Agile’ manner.
 The backend is mostly based on technologies such as Java, Spring, Sql, Hibernate, Docker, Kubernetes, while the frontend is written in Vue.
 Who you are:
You are an experienced application developer passionate about latest technologies.
You are able to work comfortably in a fast-changing environment on interesting technical challenges
You have a passion for efficiency, performance and continuous improvement
You enjoy growing and integrating team members and proactively support their continuous improvement
 What you’ll be doing 
Execute user interface designs from product requirements or UX specifications from Figma
Collaborate with backend developers to create a scalable, standardized and flexible UI architecture
Ship high-quality, elegant, well-tested, secure and clean code
Ensure software is up-to-date with latest technologies 
Participate in design discussions about new features and make sure they can be reliably integrated
Active participation in backlog grooming, sprint planning and implementation
Own and manage different phases of the software development lifecycle: coding, testing and debugging new complex software solutions
 What you need to know/have 
3+ years of experience with full-stack development, including understanding UI frameworks and back-end architecture interactions
Professional experience with frontend technologies: VueJS 2+, Vuex, HTML 5, JavaScript/Typescript, CSS, SASS
experience using Java frameworks - Spring (Spring Boot, Spring container, Spring MVC, Spring Integration, Hibernate) in developing highly available distributed systems
Good understanding of RDBMS
Experience developing Webservices (REST / SOAP)
Good understanding of REST APIs and HTTP communication
Experience with front-end tooling (npm-scripts/Webpack)
Comfortable using version control (Git)
Good communication skills (we enjoy chatting :D)
 Nice to have:
 ·Experience in writing reusable components
 · Familiarity with monitoring and observability patterns and tools
 · Experience in working within an international agile team (Scrum)
 · Previous practice with continuous integration systems (CI/CD)
 What’s in it for you: 
Performance Bonuses – based on your results & the company’s;
Electronic Meal Tickets
Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too;
#WFH & Flexible hours;
Professional GSM subscription;
Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!];
Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services;
Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring;
Wellbeing Programs – we support your Zen;
 Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology.
 Come & work for a #TopEmployer company. You could be part of an organization where great colleagues and team spirit support your professional development.
 At Orange, you can.
 We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
